answer: Each agent identity is enrolled against remotely attested enclave code (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-rooted, device-unique key; MRENCLAVE alone identifies code, not a physical chip. The verifier issues one identity per certified silicon key, so duplicating agents in virtual machines cannot mint credentials: an attacker must obtain additional supported hardware. A vertex registry can track attestations, while onyx and nectar label policy domains rather than extra identities.
